mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox FORCE INDEX (idx_video_status_outbox_status_id) WHERE status = 3 AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 3

SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 3 FOR UPDATE

SELECT paged.* FROM ( (SELECT id, event_id, vid, event_type, process_status, consumer_retry_count, consumed_at, last_attempt_at, redis_applied_at, flushed_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, consumed_at, NOW(3)) AS consumed_age_seconds FROM video_status_consumed_event FORCE INDEX (idx_video_status_consumed_status_id) WHERE process_status = 0 AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT id, event_id, vid, event_type, process_status, consumer_retry_count, consumed_at, last_attempt_at, redis_applied_at, flushed_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, consumed_at, NOW(3)) AS consumed_age_seconds FROM video_status_consumed_event FORCE INDEX (idx_video_status_consumed_status_id) WHERE process_status = 3 AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) ) AS paged ORDER BY paged.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, event_id, vid, event_type, process_status, consumer_retry_count, consumed_at, last_attempt_at, redis_applied_at, flushed_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, consumed_at, NOW(3)) AS consumed_age_seconds FROM video_status_consumed_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND process_status IN (0, 3)

mapper.update: UPDATE video_status_consumed_event SET process_status = 0, last_attempt_at = NOW(3) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND process_status = 3 AND redis_applied_at IS NULL AND payload_hash = #{payloadHash}
UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = 0, next_retry_at = NULL, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 2
